 Bangladesh recorded 1,982 new hospital admissions in the 24 hours to 8am today, while September saw the highest monthly death toll so far this year. 
 TBS Report 
 28 October, 2026, 05:00 pm 
 Last modified: 28 October, 2026, 05:03 pm 
 Illustration: TBS "> 
 Illustration: TBS 
 Nine more people died of dengue in Bangladesh in the 24 hours to 8am today (28 October), taking this year's death toll to 409. 
 During the same period, 1,982 new patients were admitted to hospitals across the country, while 2,183 patients were discharged after recovery, according to the latest health update.
 The cumulative number of dengue cases reported nationwide this year has reached 128,237, while total recoveries stand at 123,605.
 Keep updated, follow The Business Standard's Google news channel
 September recorded 148 dengue-related deaths, the highest monthly toll so far this year.
 From January to May, the mosquito-borne disease claimed five lives in total, followed by 13 deaths in June, 36 in July and 43 in August.
